input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns provision: it imposes no consent standard at all, so HDI is free to assign the Agreement (including to a competitor of ours) without notice or our consent. Our own assignment rights are unrestricted, which is fine, and there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the Agreement (the only termination rights are the 70-day launch right in 1.4 and the mutual 90-day notice right in the renewal clause), so we are not in walk-away territory. However, the clause fails even the fallback, which requires consent for non-successor assignments not to be unreasonably withheld; the vendor-side control is a material term and is entirely absent. We propose the minimal preferred-position edit: express affiliate/successor freedom for the Company, HDI assignment subject to our consent not unreasonably withheld and never to a competitor, and confirmation that our change of control gives HDI no exit or re-pricing right.

proposal.summary: Add assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors; HDI needs our consent and may not assign to a competitor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns clause, so HDI could today assign this Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without notice or consent. We have added a consent standard that keeps our freedom to assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger or sale of assets while requiring our (not unreasonably withheld) consent to an HDI assignment. If preferred, we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, re-price or suspend this Agreement.
